title: I Had Opus 5.5 Make the Same Music Video at Every Effort
description:
One rap song. Six music videos. All six were made by Claude Code with Opus 5.5 from the same prompt. 

This video also using Opus 5.5 Motion Graphics.

CHAPTERS
0:00 One song, six music videos
0:41 Low
2:05 Medium
3:30 High
4:54 xhigh
6:19 Max
7:43 Ultracode
9:08 How I did it
11:05 Time, tokens and price
11:36 Ultracode problem
13:14 Which one do you like?

⚠ Heads-up: some of these videos have bright, fast flashes.

SETUP
Claude Code 2.1.287 · Opus 5.5 · in the terminal · 2 to 4 October 2026

MUSIC
"Mirror Mirror" by Anno Domini Beats, from the YouTube Audio Library.

The six music videos and the sound effects are AI-made.

Which effort do you like most? Tell me in the comments.
